svg.aria-label: GreenBranch architecture: the browser loads the Next.js frontend from Vercel, whose server routes register runs on server-ai with an API key and the user's GitHub token. The browser then opens a WebSocket to server-ai with a single-use run_id and receives the run's events. server-ai drives server-runner over HTTP to clone, install, test, write fixes, commit and push, asks the Groq API for SEARCH/REPLACE edits, and opens the pull request through GitHub's REST API. server-runner keeps sessions in Redis and runs commands with a local or Docker executor.
svg.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: API keys and the GitHub token stay here;
FastAPI · Python · runs the fix loop
clone → test / fix loop → commit → PR
one worker: run tickets live in memory
the phone · allowed repo owners only
events: log · step · iteration · fix · pr_created · complete · error
a single-use run_id, valid for 120 s
GitHub token in an encrypted cookie · server-ai API key
Groq key · runner API key · the user's token, per run
WebSocket: run events stream to the browser
